# ADR-3011: A01: Documented break-glass role for incident lane 11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Emergency access needs audited escape hatches.

## Decision

Operators MAY adopt a documented break-glass role for incident lane 11 (A01-11) when restoring service during incidents.

## Consequences

Break-glass use pages on-call owners.
